tickerText: [TENNIS] Nakashima upsets Fritz; Tiafoe sets all-American Cincinnati semifinal — Bejlek stuns Keys to face Gauff • [SQUASH] Home hero Pérez wins 110-min Valencia final over Evans; Gohar set for Qatar Classic return • [BADMINTON] Treesa-Gayatri lock bronze at Delhi Worlds; face top-seeded Chinese pair in semis • [PICKLEBALL] 2026-27 PPA Tour opens Aug 31 at Veolia Nationals; World Pickleball Rankings debut • [TABLE TENNIS] Lebrun's first Grand Smash crown; Chinese men blank Malmö — WTT Macao next

newsItems.title: All-American Cincinnati Semifinal
newsItems.excerpt: Brandon Nakashima rallied past Taylor Fritz and Frances Tiafoe beat Lorenzo Musetti to set up a U.S. semifinal clash, while Sara Bejlek upset Madison Keys to reach her first WTA 1000 semifinal.

newsItems.title: Treesa-Gayatri Assure India Bronze
newsItems.excerpt: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand upset China's fourth seeds to reach the Delhi Worlds semifinals, guaranteeing India's first women's doubles medal in 15 years.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026-27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off Aug 31 in Cary with the Veolia Pickleball National Championships, debuting the unified World Pickleball Rankings system.

newsItems.title: Lebrun & Wang Manyu Crown Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: Felix Lebrun beat Tomokazu Harimoto 4-1 for his first WTT Grand Smash singles crown while Wang Manyu edged Wang Yidi 4-2 in an all-Chinese final.
